primary_metric: average precision averaged over clean, 10%, 30%, 50% MCAR held-out test conditions
prior_art_status: Known component overlap: pattern-specific prediction models for missingness patterns; standard held-out isotonic calibration; calibration under covariate shift. No claim made about novelty of a distinct relationship because the proposed relation cannot be instantiated from the stated clean-only training procedure.
limitations: Proposal supplies no missingness-corrupted training masks or target-regime calibration data; all KMeans inputs are identical all-zero vectors.
The held-out diagnostic tests only the resulting single global isotonic calibrator, which is not the stated 8-prototype intervention.
The synthetic dataset and three seeds do not support claims of external validity.
Isotonic ties can change average precision; AP is not a calibration metric.
warnings: scikit-learn KMeans reported one distinct cluster rather than eight; held-out test was run once after preregistration.
